name: Wat Arun
description: A riverside prang temple of porcelain mosaics opposite Thonburi’s shore.

name: Wat Pho
description: Home of a giant Reclining Buddha and a historic massage school.

name: Grand Palace
description: Gilded halls and Wat Phra Kaew share a walled riverside complex.

name: Wat Mahathat
description: Ruined towers and a famous Buddha head in tree roots mark Ayutthaya’s park.

name: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep
description: A golden chedi temple overlooks Chiang Mai from a mountain road.

name: Chiang Mai Old City
description: A moated square of temples, cafés and night markets in northern Thailand.

name: Maya Bay / Ko Phi Phi
description: Limestone cliffs and beaches on Phi Phi islands (Maya Bay has managed access).

name: Railay Beach
description: Cliffs and beaches reachable by longtail from Ao Nang.

name: Sukhothai Historical Park
description: Khmer-influenced temple ruins spread across a UNESCO park.

name: Damnoen Saduak Floating Market
description: Canal vendors sell produce and snacks from boats — busy and tourist-oriented.

name: Chatuchak Weekend Market
description: A vast weekend market with food courts among thousands of stalls.

name: Yaowarat Road
description: Bangkok’s Chinatown street of seafood, noodles and night stalls.

name: Chiang Mai Night Bazaar food
description: Evening stalls of khao soi, satay and desserts along Chang Klan.

name: Or Tor Kor Market
description: A high-quality produce market beside Chatuchak with ready-to-eat southern dishes.

name: Phuket Weekend Market / Old Town food
description: Sino-Portuguese Old Town cafés and Sunday walking-street snacks.

name: Loi Krathong
description: Floating krathong offerings light rivers and canals on a full-moon night.
